name: Can I replace just the broken glass pane in my sliding door, or do I need a whole new door?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just the broken glass pane in my sliding door, or do I need a whole new door?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, you can replace just the broken glass pane, especially if the door frame itself is undamaged and in good working condition. This is often more cost-effective than replacing the entire door unit. A professional contractor can assess your specific door to determine if a pane-only replacement is feasible and recommend the best solution based on the door's condition, age, and type.
acceptedAnswer.description: Usually, only the broken glass pane can be replaced if the door frame is intact. This is often more cost-effective than a full door replacement.
